coaching.headline: We won 30 of the match's credited kills, but towers still went 3 to 10 against us and we lost the game.
coaching.team: Lane reads were mixed across the draft: jungle (Aurora vs Crunch) and carry (Eden vs Skylar) came in favored, while midlane (Wraith vs Gadget) and offlane (Bayle vs Terra) read unfavored all game. Early objective trades were close: we won the Fangtooth fight at 9.5 but still conceded the objective, and lost the 14.9 Fangtooth fight outright 1-3, and we converted only 2 of 5 won fights into prizes all match. At 21.8 we had the man advantage, 5 against 4, and still lost the fight 2-4 at our own Fangtooth. From there towers mounted against us, 10 to 3, even as we held our own on kills (30 credited). The collapse came at 31.7, when Crunch alone killed all five of us in 42 seconds near Orb Prime, and the Inhibitor fight at 34.9 opened the Core a minute later.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: At 21.8, a 5-vs-4 man advantage at Fangtooth should have been a clean win; instead we lost it 2-4, and from there structures swung hard to them (10 towers to 3).
coaching.whatWorked: Eden's two solo kills at their Outer Tower (17.7, 17.8) — picking off Dekker then Skylar alone — opened the game's only clean, sustained push.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,497 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Terra offlane players this patch (27% of the team's). The damage came from Tainted Guard, Fire Blossom, Elafrost.
Unstoppable Force at rank 3: 105s base, about 70.9s by the end (32% shorter) from 48 ability haste: Tainted Guard 8, Elafrost 15, Inquisition 10, Mutilator 15.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Terra dealt 53,879 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +45 physical power from items.
Tainted Guard (item): On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.
Fire Blossom (item): Burn nearby Enemy Units: Deals 15 (+1%) Damage each second.Firestorm - When Heatwave damages a Target: Deals 5% more damage each second, up to 40%.
Elafrost (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 70 (+2%) Damage On-Hit around the Target. Slows by 35% for 1.5s. Damage is increased by 60% against Monsters.
Inquisition (item): On Ability Cast: Emit a wave of energy. Deals 65 (+1.5%) Damage to Enemies in the area. Damage is increased by 45% against Monsters.
Mutilator (item): On Successsful Basic Attacks: Deal 1% of their Max Health as Damage.
Razorback (crest): Gain 20% Physical Armor and Magical Armor for 5s. Reflect 15% of Pre-Mitigated Damage received from Heroes as Damage.
Axe Retrieval (augment): Highland Hurl deals 20% more damage and can now be picked up, reducing its Cooldown by 45%.

Sustain: 12% omnivamp; 8% heal and shield power; Transference: Upon Shields expiring: 50% of its remaining value is restored as Health over 3s. Reduced to 25% for Ally Shields.; 7,783 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1580 health, +198 physical armor, +85 magical armor; took 49,788 damage, mitigated 97,917, died 4 times.

(changes Highland Hurl, 6.4s cooldown with their haste) Field: 47.2% in 985 games, 23% of picks, level the hero-role's 47.2%.

(game text: While off cooldown and above 30% Max Health, gain 15% increased Physical and Magical Armor. Falling below 30% Health consumes this bonus to grant a 4s Shield equal to 150% of your total Armor (CD: 75–32.5s).) Field: 48.4% in 1717 games, 40% of picks, above the hero-role's 47.2%.

Loadout minor Cold Hearted: Enemies who basic attack you slow down. Makes it harder for attackers to kite away from Terra. (game text: Enemies that basic attack you lose 3% movement speed for 2s (stacks 4x).) Field: 50.2% in 404 games, 24% of picks, above the hero-role's 47.2%.

Loadout minor Icy Touch: Your basic attacks lower the enemy's attack speed. Helps Terra win duels against attack-based heroes. (game text: Your Basic Attacks reduce enemy Attack Speed by 3% for 3s (stacks 4x).) Field: 48% in 612 games, 36% of picks, level the hero-role's 47.2%.

Loadout crest Razorback: More armor and reflected damage for 5s. Pop it when the enemy team focuses Terra, especially during Unstoppable Force. (game text: Echidna:  Gain 20% Physical Armor and Magical Armor for 5s. Reflect 15% of Pre-Mitigated Damage received from Heroes as Damage.) Field: 47.6% in 1490 games, 34% of picks, level the hero-role's 47.2%.

Stack (Kept alive in fights): 4 effects on one trigger: Transference, Mutilator, Razorback, Idrisil. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

The Eternal was part of it: Idrisil (Cold Hearted + Icy Touch) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; kept alive in fights), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.

lines: Lead story: Soaked the fights. 649 damage mitigated a minute, more than 95% of Wraith mid players this patch.
Back It Up! at rank 3: 95s base, about 60.1s by the end (37% shorter) from 58 ability haste: Alternata 10, Tainted Trident 10, Mutilator 15, The Perforator 15, Ortus 8.
15 takedowns (14 kills, 1 assists) fed: Ortus (Limit Breaker).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Wraith dealt 40,487 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +292 physical power from items.

Penetration: Alternata 12, Vanquisher 12, Tainted Trident 11, The Perforator 8, Ortus 5, The Perforator ignores 30%; against Gadget (level 18: about 110 physical armor, 29 after penetration; took 13,644 physical damage from heroes, 63% of all hero damage they took) and Crunch (level 18: about 177 physical armor, 76 after penetration; took 29,879 physical damage from heroes, 65% of all hero damage they took) that is about 63% and 57% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Alternata (item): Your Alternate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Blighted Unit: Deal 3 (+6%)% additional Damage.
Mutilator (item): On Successsful Basic Attacks: Deal 1% of their Max Health as Damage.
The Perforator (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Slows by 10% for 1s.
Weald (Eternal): Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage.
Sustain: 12% omnivamp; 2,985 healing recorded.
Toughness: +275 health; took 38,201 damage, mitigated 23,356, died 6 times.

Lesson: Wraith's penetration cut through: Gadget took about 63% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 18 their armor was about 110, about 29 after 48 flat + 30% penetration).

Loadout augment Sniper's Bounty: Killing blows with Knock, Knock! give extra gold, a lot more on heroes. Use the sniper shot to last-hit minions and finish fleeing heroes from range. (game text: Killing Blows from Knock Knock! grant +6g, increased to +40g for Heroes.) Field: 49.9% in 3470 games, 63% of picks, above the hero-role's 47.4%.

Loadout Eternal Weald: Damaging a hero below 30% health fires missiles that pass through walls. Pairs with a long-range Knock, Knock! hit to finish someone running away. (game text: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage. Missiles travel through walls and disappear after 3000u. 10s cooldown per Hero. On-hit effects apply at 20% effectiveness.) [7 + 1 a level: 25 at level 18] Field: 48.3% in 904 games, 16% of picks, level the hero-role's 47.4%.

Loadout minor Forage: Plain economy: a bit more gold and XP from each minion or monster kill. (game text: Gain 3 additional Gold and 3 additional XP per Minion or Monster kill.) Field: 49.4% in 699 games, 77% of picks, above the hero-role's 47.4%.

Loadout minor Wind-Rider: Gives attack speed for 4s after a dash, leap, teleport or leaving stealth. Surprise, Surprise! gives Camouflage, which the text does not list, so Wraith has few sure triggers for it. (game text: Gain 15% (+1% per Level) Bonus Attack Speed for 4s after using a Dash, Leap, Teleport, or upon leaving Stealth.) Field: 46.5% in 591 games, 65% of picks, level the hero-role's 47.4%.

Loadout crest Ortus: A burst of speed and physical power, and takedowns during it grant permanent power. Pop it before a pick so your snipe and follow-up hit harder. (game text: Limit Breaker:  Gain 20% Movement Speed and 10% Physical Power for 7s. Takedowns within 7s permanently grant 3 Physical Power and refreshes the duration.) Field: 51.2% in 1124 games, 20% of picks, above the hero-role's 47.4%.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Trident, Mutilator, The Perforator. Wraith has 2 damaging abilities, and 58 ability haste brought them back 37% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Weald.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Vanquisher, Weald. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, The Perforator. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
The Eternal was part of it: Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; finishing damage on low-health targets), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 3 of the 5 players Wraith killed built physical armor (Crunch, Terra, Dekker). We killed Wraith 6 times.

Copy it? Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider): 48.2% in 514 Wraith midlane games, level with the hero's 47.4%; this 3-item core: 49% in 98 games, below the 50.3% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
